grants.description: Verify your identity and National Insurance number
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and match your records with DWP systems

grants.description: Share your income and employment details with DWP
grants.purpose: To verify your earnings are £196 or less per week after tax, National Insurance and expenses

grants.description: Check the disability benefit status of the person you care for
grants.purpose: To confirm the person you care for receives a qualifying disability benefit at the required rate

grants.description: Check your existing benefit claims and entitlements
grants.purpose: To understand how Carer's Allowance will interact with your other benefits and inform you of the impact

grants.description: Check benefits of the person you care for to assess impact
grants.purpose: To inform you and the person you care for if their benefits (such as severe disability premium) will be affected by your Carer's Allowance claim

grants.description: Provide details about the care you provide
grants.purpose: To verify you provide at least 35 hours of care per week

grants.description: Provide bank account details for payment
grants.purpose: To pay your Carer's Allowance weekly or every 4 weeks

grants.description: Provide details of any education or training courses
grants.purpose: To verify you're not in full-time education or studying 21+ hours per week

grants.description: Verify your immigration status and right to claim benefits
grants.purpose: To verify you're not subject to immigration control and meet residency requirements

revocation.mechanism: Contact the Carer's Allowance Unit on 0800 731 0297 or write to them. You can also revoke consent through your GOV.UK account.
revocation.effect: Your application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before a decision. If you revoke consent after approval, your Carer's Allowance will stop and you must report the change in circumstances.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide bank details on your behalf. Agent cannot make decisions about benefit trade-offs (e.g., if your claim will stop the care recipient's severe disability premium, you must explicitly confirm you want to proceed). Agent cannot declare care hours or care activities without your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot complete the application if complex benefit interactions require human decision-making (will hand off to DWP adviser).
